newsitem.title: UK: Securicor shares up on Cellnet bid report.
newsitem.headline: Securicor shares up on Cellnet bid report.

text.p: Shares in Securicor Plc rose on Monday after a report that British Telecommunications Plc was planning a fresh attempt to get government clearance to take control of jointly-owned mobile phone group Cellnet.
Securicor shares were up 8p at 311-1/2p by 0934 GMT, after earlier reaching an eight-month high of 314p, while BT shares were down 2p at 433-1/2.

The Sunday Times newspaper quoted BT chief executive Sir Peter Bonfield as saying he planned to approach the Department of Trade and Industry after the forthcoming election to buy Securicor's 40 percent stake in Cellnet.

A spokesman for BT said: "We have said many times before that we would be interested in taking on the rest of Cellnet at the right price, the only thing new in the Sunday Times story is that we will raise the issue again after the election, but it would be very surprising if we didn't do that."

"Our position is fairly well known," said a Securicor spokesman, "if BT or any other party made an offer at the right price we would be bound to consider it but until that point we are happy with the investment." -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4367
